import hashlib,json
from pypdf import PdfReader
from v3_revision import ROOT,dump
r=ROOT/'results/revision-20261023/round2';p=ROOT/'manuscript/revision-v3/paper.pdf';c=json.loads((p.parent/'paper-content.json').read_text());prior=json.loads((r/'post-correction-audit/prior-table-bodies.json').read_text())
tables=[{'caption':b['caption'],'headers':b['headers'],'rows':b['rows']} for s in c['sections'] for b in s['blocks'] if b['type']=='table'];assert tables==prior['tables']
old=json.loads((r/'final-generation-information-scope-g13.json').read_text());oldids={x['png_sha256']:x['page'] for x in old['pages_by_identity']}
imgs=sorted((ROOT/'.scratch/round2/pdf-dq-basis-g14').glob('page-*.png'));assert len(imgs)==len(PdfReader(p).pages)==40
pages=[{'page':i+1,'png_sha256':hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'byte_identical_g13_page':oldids.get(hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest())} for i,q in enumerate(imgs)]
measure=json.loads((ROOT/'results/revision-20261023/rendering-summary.json').read_text());assert measure['main_pages_including_references']==15
out={'pdf_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'pages':40,'main_pages_including_references':15,'dpi':150,'render_directory':'.scratch/round2/pdf-dq-basis-g14','pages_by_identity':pages,'changed_pages':[x['page'] for x in pages if x['byte_identical_g13_page'] is None],'prior_table_bodies_unchanged':len(tables),'scope':'DQ null stated on raw issue-known instrument basis; common diagnostic-only centering/scaling explained. No numerical test result or model changed.'}
dump(r/'final-generation-dq-basis-g14.json',out);print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items() if k!='pages_by_identity'}))
